name: Frozen Apricots
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Drain apricots, and cut in small pieces.
To the syrup add enough water to make four cups, and cook with sugar five minutes; strain, add apricots, cool, and freeze.
Peaches may be used instead of apricots.
To make a richer dessert, add the whip from two cups cream when frozen to a mush, and continue freezing.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
